svg.title: Control reviewer and judge inputs separately
svg.desc: Generation and judging are separate roles, each with assigned inputs, explicit protocol, and saved outputs. Judging can deliberately receive several reviews of one manuscript. Exclusion of other context is a condition to configure and test, not a property of headless execution alone.
svg.text: Saved review · own input and run record
Saved judgment · own input and run record
Other cases and prior conversations stay outside
